comments.author: @kenmartin1919
comments.text:
They have phones, smart phones, & yes they are non-violent. The Amish use solar panels today for electricity (who would not want to pay an electric bill). 
They have no health insurance. They pay in cash when modern medicine is needed via a hospital bill. 
They do not have to register for the draft. They are peaceful. 
Some young people leave. That choice is allowed yet they will then be shunned. 
Even adults leave. Yet they grow. They are prosperous. They buy land and build houses and land. 
Some customs are absolutely harsh. 
But they live in peace. 
The women have it harder if they have an abusive husband or the community has unreal expectations upon a young widow.
